top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a game-changer by my standard: a small molecule recruits a ubiquitin ligase and the cell destroys a protein with no active site to occupy, a principle reproduced across many ligases, targets and laboratories. Crews and Deshaies conceived the PROTAC concept and Handa identified cereblon, which makes the glue branch a mechanism, so one citation on induced proximity to the ubiquitin ligase machinery fits three names. Nitrogenase is mature on structure but the catalytic cycle is open; C-N coupling is clean but extends a 2010 concept; phase separation lacks tested in-cell quantitative evidence.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; the Warshel postdoc link is unrelated to any credited name in the slate
